messages:
Sam: copy jam — quick sync on landing pages for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Need hero lines, one-liners for launch posts, webinar hooks, and inbound routing. Can meet 11:15? Doc: https://redwoodinference.app/briefs/landing-copy
Maria: can do 11:15. main ask: make Hosted hero velocity/cost, Dedicated predictability + SLA, Private compliance + VPC.
Alex: For launch posts we should lead with benchmarks: latency ms @ throughput and $/1M tokens. Priya can own benchmark narrative?
Priya: I can. I'll pull last week's perf curves and cost model. Want 2 variants: 'real-time' and 'economy' hooks.
Jon: I'll push hero comps in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/landing-frames — will include three panels per mode. Preview by 13:00.
Sam: CTA variants: 'Try Hosted', 'Reserve Dedicated', 'Talk to Sales (Private)'. Also need webinar sign-up CTAs and demo slots.
Casey: For inbound routing: Hosted leads -> marketing SDR queue, Dedicated -> AE outreach tier 1, Private -> enterprise ops, flag with tag 'private-bid'.
Maria: Add UTMs and form hidden field 'deployment_mode'. Also low friction webinar registration with calendar add.
Sam: UTM snippet:
```
utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_content=hosted
```
Alex: Webinar plan: live demo + benchmark walkthrough + customer panel. 45 min + 15 Q&A. Date options: Jun 10 or Jun 17. Poll? :raising_hand:
Priya: Jun 17 preferred. I'll assemble slides: perf, cost, routing, security.
Jon: Reminder to include microcopy near toggles: 'Pin to Dedicated for reserved throughput' etc.
Sam: Action items: Maria finalize hero lines by EOD, Jon comps by 13:00, Priya benchmark slides by EOD tomorrow, Casey confirm routing rules by EOD. I'll assemble launch post copy for review.
Maria: ack. I'll post final lines here when done. :thumbsup:
marketing-bot: Event created -> Webinar: 'Serving LLMs: latency, cost, and deployment choices' (ID 7842). RSVP link: https://redwoodinference.app/events/7842
Sam: Thanks — closing thread and will ping again after copy pass.
